notes: *shall have plenty of* is read as the whole rendering of `שָׂבַע`: *plenty* carries the lexeme that *have* alone does not write, so rule 44's supplied-object clause does not reach it; the competing reading leaving *plenty* added is named in the unit.
*after* and the second *of* are valency prepositions reaching bare complements (rules 44 and 33) and stay with the predicates.
The margin *Or, vain things* was read and set aside under rule 38.
